answer: Its pulse drives the system, each identity requiring completion of a public low-value task verified against a rotating sable marker, with the task time added to each clone's record. Honest work settles the fee, making maintaining one identity far cheaper than paying the fee and waiting through the dune queue for every copy. The sable marker rotates steadily, ensuring each pulse of work is properly tracked. This mechanism keeps per-identity costs low while preventing queue congestion.
